dedupe_keys.name: santa barbara and ventura counties transportation emergency preparedness plan 2020

description: The Transportation Emergency Preparedness Plan of the Ventura County Transportation Commission (VCTC) and the Santa Barbara County Association of Governments (SBCAG), prepared by Terra Firma Enterprises with Claris Strategy and CPARS Consulting and funded by a Caltrans Adaptation Planning Grant, is a bi-county plan dated 17 December 2020 for transport in disasters affecting one or both counties. Coverage: transport infrastructure and transit resources of both counties, vulnerable populations, threat summaries and their prioritisation, concept of operations and activation levels, roles of local, state and federal agencies, business and community stakeholders, evacuations and alternatives when normal modes are unavailable, mutual aid and memorandums of understanding, and EOC position checklists. It records repeated closures of the main rail and highway links by fires (Jesusita 2009 to Gaviota 2019), floods (1969 to 1998) and landslides and debris flows (La Conchita 1995 and 2005, Montecito 2018). Format and access: a PDF of about 267 pages. Licence and cost: free to read; marked for official use only, in a version without personal information. Caveats: a plan, not an evaluated response. The roles, activation levels and transit resources can set agents and rules in evacuation and emergency response simulations. It relates to the National Transit Database and the Social Vulnerability Index in the catalogue.
